# XomSom

> Post free classified ads and connect with people near you: rooms for rent, jobs, items for sale, services and events. Every ad runs 24 hours in your city and neighborhood.

XomSom (xomsom.com) is a free local classified ads board. Product, service, event, job and rental ads run for 24 hours and are shown one by one, at random, to people browsing the chosen country, province, ward and industry — in the XomSom Atom web app at https://xomsom.com/ads/. Browsing needs no account; posting is free (up to 3 running ads per account). The app interface is in English and Vietnamese, and search understands English and Vietnamese with or without accents.

## Main pages

- [Free Classified Ads – Buy, Sell & Connect Locally](https://xomsom.com/): XomSom is a free local ad board. Post rooms for rent, jobs, items for sale, services and events — each ad runs for 24 hours and pops up in front of people browsing the right country, city, neighborhood and industry. Browsing needs no account, and search works in English and Vietnamese.
- [Live Local Ads – Browse Free Classifieds Near You](https://xomsom.com/ads/): Browse live classified ads near you: rooms for rent, jobs, items for sale, services and events. Every ad runs 24 hours — filter by country, city, neighborhood and 21 industries. Free, no sign-up.
- [Classified Ads Map – From the Globe to Your Neighborhood](https://xomsom.com/ads/map/): Find classified ads on an interactive map: countries with ads light up on the globe, and Vietnam opens down to its 34 provinces, cities and wards — rentals, jobs and deals near you.
- [Classified Ads by Industry – 21 Categories, Live Now](https://xomsom.com/ads/grid/): See every live ad grouped into 21 industries — real estate, jobs, food, beauty, vehicles, electronics and more — with photos, prices, places and time left. Filter by city and neighborhood.
- [Free Ads by Industry – Browse 21 Local Categories](https://xomsom.com/ads/industry/): Pick an industry to see its live local ads and post your own for free: real estate and rentals, food and drink, beauty, education, vehicles, logistics, services and 14 more.

## Legal

- [XomSom Terms of Use & Posting Rules](https://xomsom.com/ads/legal/terms/): XomSom (xomsom.com) and its Atom board (xomsom.com/ads) are a short-lived ad board run by GOLDEN KEY IT SOLUTIONS JOINT STOCK COMPANY ("we", "us"): each product, service, event, job or rental post runs for 24 hours and is shown at random to viewers by place and industry. By viewing or posting you agree to these terms and the XomSom Privacy Policy.
- [XomSom Privacy Policy](https://xomsom.com/ads/legal/privacy/): This policy explains which data XomSom (xomsom.com) and its Atom board collect, display, keep and delete. We use data only to run the post board — we do not sell data or use it for tracking ads.

## Key facts

- Run time: 24 hours per ad; expired ads kept 7 days for renewal, then deleted.
- Limits: up to 3 running ads per account; up to 6 images and 1 video per ad.
- Ad types: product, service, event, job, rental. 21 industries.
- Place: country → province or city → ward (Vietnam is mapped in full: 34 provinces and cities since July 2025), plus street address and optional map pin (opens Google Maps).
- Three ways to browse the same ads: live 3D globe (/ads/), map (/ads/map/) and industry grid (/ads/grid/).
- Each ad card shows for 12 seconds; viewers can pause a card.
- Contact: viewers call, message on Zalo or open the link in the ad — XomSom takes no fee and does not handle payments.
- Price: free to post and to browse. No third-party tracking ads.
- Operator: GOLDEN KEY IT SOLUTIONS JOINT STOCK COMPANY — 670 Đoàn Văn Bơ, Khu phố 16, Phường Xóm Chiếu, TP. HCM. Contact: kimthiendung@gmail.com.

## How to post an ad

1. **Sign in** — Tap the account button at the bottom right. Browsing needs no account — only posting does.
2. **Write your ad** — Pick an ad type and an industry, add a title, description and price, up to 6 photos, a video and how to reach you (phone, Zalo or a link).
3. **Choose the place** — Country, province, ward and street address — add a map pin if you like. Your ad shows to people browsing that area.
4. **Go live for free** — Your ad appears in turn, mixed at random with the others, for 24 hours — nothing else to do.
5. **Get contacted** — Viewers open your ad, check the map and call or message you on Zalo directly.
6. **Renew when you need** — In "My posts" you can edit, hide, rerun, renew for another 24 hours or delete. Expired ads are kept for 7 days.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is XomSom?

XomSom is a free local classified ads board. Product, service, event, job and rental ads run for 24 hours and are shown one by one, at random, to people browsing the right country, city, neighborhood and industry — on a live 3D globe, a map or an industry grid.

### Is it really free to post ads?

Yes. Posting and browsing are currently free. Each account can have up to 3 running ads at once; hidden or expired ads don't count.

### How long does an ad stay live?

An ad runs for 24 hours from posting, then comes down. Expired ads stay in "My posts" for 7 days so you can renew them for another 24 hours; after that they are deleted.

### Do I need an account to browse?

No. Open xomsom.com/ads and start browsing right away; only posting needs a sign-in.

### Can I use XomSom in English?

Yes. The app works in English and Vietnamese, and anyone can browse or post. Ad types, industries and place names are stored in both languages, so English searches like "real estate" or "Da Nang" also find ads written in Vietnamese.

### Which countries and cities are covered?

Ads can be posted for any country and show up on the globe. Vietnam is mapped in full detail: all 34 provinces and centrally run cities (new boundaries since July 2025), including Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi and Da Nang, down to ward level.

### How do I find a room or apartment for rent?

Pick your city and ward, then filter by "For rent" or the "Real estate & construction" industry. Owners list rooms, apartments and shopfronts with photos, prices and a map pin; you contact them directly by phone or Zalo.

### Can I post a job or find work near me?

Yes. The "Job" type is for urgent hires, seasonal and part-time work. Job seekers pick the ward they live in to see nearby jobs first, or search words like "hiring", "waiter", "sales" or "delivery".

### Where can I sell a used motorbike, phone or furniture quickly?

Post a "Product" with a price and up to 6 photos in the right industry (for example "Automotive", "Electronics & telecom" or "Furniture & home"). People around you see it within 24 hours and contact you directly — no middleman, no fee.

### How do I advertise a restaurant, shop or local service for free?

Post a "Service", or an "Event" for an opening or promotion, with your address and a map pin. People browsing that area see it and can open Google Maps for directions. After 24 hours, renew it from "My posts".

### Does search work without Vietnamese accents?

Yes. "Hồ Chí Minh", "ho chi minh", "bán lẻ", "ban le" and "retail" all match. Shortcut: ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

### Which industries can I post in?

21 industries: Food & beverage, FMCG, Beauty, Fashion & textile, Retail & e-commerce, Technology, Electronics & telecom, Finance, Real estate & construction, Healthcare & pharma, Education, Tourism & hospitality, Automotive, Agriculture, Logistics, Packaging & printing, Furniture & home, Energy & environment, Manufacturing, Professional services, Other.

### Will it run on an older phone?

Yes. Filters offer 3 display levels; "Low" uses simpler graphics so older devices run smoothly, with every feature intact.

### What can't I post?

Banned or counterfeit goods, scams, "easy work, high pay" lures, sexual or violent content, anything infringing someone else's copyright or personal data, and regulated trades without a licence. Breaking ads are removed — see the full posting rules.
